purpose: Operational source matrix for the indicator catalogue. It converts high-level measurement requirements into reusable source/series definitions while keeping methodology and vintage explicit.
primary_source: World Bank World Development Indicators for broad cross-country comparability; specialist sources override it when their definitions are superior.

world_bank_series.source: World Bank WDI; gross capital formation is not identical to government investment

specialist_sources.domain: GDP, inflation, fiscal balance, debt, external accounts, forecasts
specialist_sources.use: Cross-check and fiscal/debt definitions where WDI is insufficient

specialist_sources.domain: EU government revenue, expenditure, deficit and debt
specialist_sources.use: Primary comparative fiscal layer for EU member states

specialist_sources.domain: energy balances, electricity generation, imports, renewables
employment, unemployment, wages, hours, labour force

specialist_sources.use: trade partners, product concentration and supply-chain edges

specialist_sources.domain: energy, electricity, oil, gas, coal, emissions
European electricity generation, load, cross-border flows and grid data
tax, productivity, labour, education, health, governance and pensions
banking, credit, international banking, financial stability

observation_schema.rule: A value without a source, period and unit is not promoted to a validated observation.

api_strategy.phase_1: Cache a small stable set of annual indicators for all 195 countries.
api_strategy.phase_2: Add quarterly/monthly macro indicators where definitions remain comparable.
api_strategy.phase_3: Add bilateral trade, energy flows, infrastructure and ownership relationships.
api_strategy.phase_4: Attach historical snapshots and revisions rather than overwriting prior observations.

quality_controls: Do not mix current USD and PPP values under one field.
Do not call central-government debt and general-government debt the same measure.
Do not treat gross capital formation as government investment.
Do not treat net energy imports as an electricity-mix measure.
Do not infer religion from nationality.
Do not infer political affiliation from demographic correlation.
Store conflicts between official sources rather than silently choosing a winner when definitions differ.
